environment.description: EC2 c5.xlarge instance running Amazon Linux 2 in a public subnet (10.0.1.0/24) with an Internet Gateway attached. Security group allows all outbound traffic (0.0.0.0/0). The monolith binary is compiled with gcc -O2 (no ASAN, no stack canaries via -fno-stack-protector). Instance has IAM role with s3:GetObject on sensitive buckets. glibc 2.26 tcache enabled (exploitable double-free to arbitrary write).
